meta.basis: Standalone, INR crore unless noted. Fiscal year ends 31 March.
meta.sources: Axis Bank quarterly press releases, Q4FY26 & Q1FY27 earnings-call transcripts, FY25 integrated annual report, and financial press. Every figure traceable to primary filings except where flagged.
meta.disclaimer: Reconstruction for study. Peer figures are approximate/secondary and marked. Not investment advice.

targets.note: Management aspirations, not guidance. FY26 actuals: ROE 13.15%, NIM 3.65% — both below aspiration.

one_offs.detail: Tightened NPA recognition on cash-credit/OD & one-time-settled accounts -> gross slippage spiked to 3.13%, GNPA optically 1.57%, credit cost 1.38%. Recognition change, not underlying deterioration.
One-time standard-asset provision on 2 discontinued crop-loan variants, per RBI advisory after FY25 inspection. PAT -26% to Rs 5,090 cr. Writeback possible by Mar-2028. RBI flagged no NPA divergence.
Income-tax authorities allowed tax depreciation on Citi consumer intangibles (Rs 8,714 cr, amortized FY23). One-time PAT boost.
Voluntary standard-asset buffer for macro/geopolitical uncertainty. Not credit-driven. Still undrawn as of Q1 FY27; management framed provision + tax benefit + trading loss as ~net-neutral.
Depressed reported revenue and inflated the quarter's cost-to-income ratio.

bottlenecks.title: NIM compression + structurally thinner liability franchise
bottlenecks.evidence: NIM fell ~53 bps across the window, 3.99% (Q2FY25) -> 3.46% (Q1FY27, management-called 'cycle bottom'). Q1FY27 34bps YoY drop = 19bps repo cuts + 16bps mix. CASA thinned 41% -> 38%. Directly caps RoA and underpins the valuation discount.
bottlenecks.mgmt_view: 3.8% 'through-cycle' NIM target 12-18 months post last rate cut; no hard bridge given.

bottlenecks.title: Deposit mobilization / high LDR
bottlenecks.evidence: LDR ran 91-93% (high vs system). But Q1FY27 deposits +18% vs advances +19% is near-balanced, and cost of funds fell ~35 bps YoY as the rate cycle turned. Constraint has migrated into margin.
bottlenecks.mgmt_view: Shifted from chasing CASA ratio to granular, stable, lower-cost deposits; NTB balances +53% YoY.

bottlenecks.title: Asset-quality volatility & disclosure credibility
bottlenecks.evidence: Three straight quarters of lumpy provisioning (Q1FY26 technical Rs 821cr; Q2FY26 RBI-advised Rs 1,231cr; Q4FY26 precautionary Rs 2,001cr). Underlying book is fine (GNPA 1.23-1.28%, NNPA ~0.39%, PCR ~70%) but earnings predictability suffered -> Nuvama downgrade to Hold, target cut to Rs 1,180.
bottlenecks.mgmt_view: 'Slippages attributable to technical criteria will not result in an economic loss' (CFO); conservatism as 'strategic advantage'.

bottlenecks.title: Persistent valuation discount vs ICICI / HDFC
bottlenecks.evidence: ~30% P/E discount (Axis ~12-14x vs ICICI ~17x, HDFC ~19x). RoA ~1.5-1.85% vs ICICI ~2.4%, HDFC ~2.0%. The gap on RoA is real; re-rating hinges on NIM & earnings-consistency recovery.
bottlenecks.mgmt_view: GPS framework (Growth, Profitability, Sustainability); 18% ROE aspiration.

bottlenecks.title: Governance / CEO succession overhang
bottlenecks.evidence: CEO Amitabh Chaudhry's term ends 31 Dec 2027, no named successor. Deputy MD Rajiv Anand retired Aug-2025 and became MD & CEO of IndusInd Bank — senior talent lost to a rival. Board runs with 2 EDs; RBI expects a 3rd.

bottlenecks.title: Unsecured retail & MFI stress
bottlenecks.evidence: Early flagger of cards/personal-loan stress in FY25; guided normalization by ~Q2FY26, Q1FY27 delinquencies improving. MFI is ~0.6-0.7% of total advances — immaterial vs MFI-heavy peers.

bottlenecks.title: Citibank integration
bottlenecks.evidence: Deal completed 2023 (~Rs 11,949 cr; Rs 5,728 cr Q4FY23 acquisition loss; ~Rs 1,500 cr integration cost; early deposit/AUM attrition). Technical migration done in 2024. Now cited mainly as a positive (top-3 cards) plus the FY26 tax benefit.
bottlenecks.mgmt_view: Underpins premium cards, Burgundy wealth, salary franchises.
